abstract.t: This specification provides a mechanism for an application to use an identity assertion to obtain an access token for a third-party API by coordinating through an identity provider that the downstream Resource Authorization Server already trusts for single sign-on (SSO), using OAuth 2.0 Token Exchange (RFC 8693) and the JWT Profile for OAuth 2.0 Authorization Grants (RFC 7523). This pattern is informally referred to as Cross-App Access (XAA).
